cues: Say takes to before a listener: he said to me.
Tell takes the listener directly, with no to: he told me.
Speak to somebody, or speak a language.
And ask somebody about or for something.
text: Say, tell, speak and ask. Say takes to before a listener: he said to me. Tell takes the listener directly, with no to: he told me. Speak to somebody, or speak a language. And ask somebody about or for something.
